rationale: This keeps the current reverse-tail family intact but changes the recurrence curriculum to spend early training on a very low-gain recurrent tail, then stage the earlier reverse blocks in later. The hypothesis is that under a 600s budget the strongest recurrent block should stay active while the other repeated tail paths enter more cautiously, reducing early optimization noise and preserving the late export-aligned tail behavior.
title: Reverse-Tail Low-Gain Stage Warmup
